passages.provision_quote: the assessor shall use a valuation factor of two and one-half percent.
passages.note: Sets a general personal-property depreciation valuation factor statewide; it is a tax-administration rule, not an incentive deal to attract a business.
House Final Reading vote page shows Weninger voting Y on HB2822, a general depreciation-schedule bill.
Bill status page names Weninger as prime sponsor of HB2822, signed by the Governor.

rows.reasoning: HB2822 only adjusts the statewide depreciation valuation factor used to assess personal property for tax purposes; it is a general tax-administration rule for existing property owners, not an incentive, deal, or subsidy aimed at attracting a business or major employer, so it does not speak to the dimension the rungs differ on (e.g. rung 4's 'offer large tax breaks and infrastructure to attract major employers').
